title: Nourishing Smoky Thai Horseradish Kanom Jeen
description: A smoky and bouncy Thai dish featuring horseradish, wood-fired baked to perfection, this low-calorie friendly kanom jeen is a romantic treat for any occasion. It combines the spiciness of horseradish with the creaminess of coconut milk.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the rice flour and water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape them into kanom jeen.
Place the kanom jeen on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kanom jeen in the wood-fired oven for 15 minutes, or until they are lightly browned.
In a separate pan, combine the grated horseradish, coconut milk, fish balls, wood-fired baked chicken, Thai basil, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the kanom jeen with the smoky horseradish sauce and garnish with additional Thai basil if desired.
